data.source_title: Language Access Provisions of the Final Rule Implementing Section 1557 of the Affordable Care Act
data.locator: Page 2, Requirements and Use of a Qualified Interpreter; page 3, language assistance services
data.source_setting: U.S. covered health programs/entities, including hospitals; HHS Office for Civil Rights guidance on Section 1557.
data.source_period: HHS guidance PDF accessed 2026-10-10; describes the final rule, not observed service utilization.
value: offer a qualified interpreter when interpretation is requested
support accurate, impartial communication with specialized vocabulary
provide language assistance timely and without charge under the guidance
data.source_evidence_basis: HHS defines interpreter qualifications and states language-assistance expectations for covered entities; AHRQ hospital discharge guidance separately describes arranging interpreters, use during discharge teaching, and documenting interpreter/agency.
data.limitations: The HHS document is legal guidance and does not quantify interpreter availability, wait time, mode mix, or hospital-specific workflows. Applicability depends on current law and covered-entity status.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Add an interpreter request/connection and interpretation-supported encounter as a coordination resource when needed, including discharge teaching; do not assume language preference or interpreter duration.
